descriptions.w3d_component_construct_80068570: Constructs a component with two banks of ten names and two titles, clears its interfaces and marks the type active.
descriptions.w3d_component_destroy_80098c2c: Clears the published instance pointer, releases a handle, then runs the base destructor.
descriptions.w3d_component_construct_800a50a8: Runs the base constructor, installs the vtable, default-constructs a label and clears a held interface.
descriptions.w3d_component_destroy_800a50f4: Releases a held interface and the label string, then runs the base destructor.
descriptions.w3d_component_destroy_800beeb0: Deletes an owned member, releases three held interfaces, then runs the base destructor.
